description: For countable structures \(M,N\) with the same age \(K\) and its extension property, every embedding \(f:S\hookrightarrow N\) of a finitely generated substructure \(S\) of \(M\) extends to an isomorphism \(e:M\cong N\) with \(e\mathbin{\upharpoonright}S=f\). In relational languages these substructures are finite.
